requirements.summary: Add frontend route guards to all /admin/* routes that check admin status and redirect non-admin users to home page with informative message
acceptanceCriteria: Route guard checks admin status before allowing access to /admin/add-poem
Route guard checks admin status before allowing access to /admin/collections
Route guard checks admin status before allowing access to admin panel
Non-admin users are redirected to home page when attempting to access admin routes
User sees a toast notification explaining they lack admin permissions

file_operations.description: Create a route guard component that wraps admin routes, checks if the authenticated user is an admin using the isCallerAdmin backend method, and redirects non-admin users to the home page with a toast notification explaining insufficient permissions. Use useInternetIdentity to verify authentication, useIsCallerAdmin query hook to check admin status, and useNavigate for redirection. Display a loading state while checking admin status. Verify the authorization component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a new React Query hook useIsCallerAdmin that calls actor.isCallerAdmin() to check if the current authenticated user has admin privileges. The hook should be enabled only when the actor is available and should return boolean admin status. Include proper error handling and retry configuration.

Wrap all admin routes (/admin/add-poem, /admin/collections, /admin/panel) with the AdminRouteGuard component to enforce admin-only access. Keep the route structure but nest each admin route's component inside AdminRouteGuard. Ensure non-admin routes remain accessible to all users.

requirements.summary: Hide admin navigation links (Add Poem, Collections, Admin Panel) in the header for non-admin users so only the owner sees these navigation options
acceptanceCriteria: Add Poem link is hidden for non-admin users
Collections management link is hidden for non-admin users
Admin Panel link is hidden for non-admin users
Navigation links are visible and functional for admin user
Home link remains visible to all users

file_operations.description: Conditionally render admin navigation links (Add Poem, Collections, Admin Panel) based on admin status. Use the useIsCallerAdmin hook to check if the current user is an admin. Only display these links when the user is authenticated and isAdmin returns true. Keep the Home link and LoginButton visible to all users. Show the notification bell only for authenticated users. Verify the authorization component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Ensure public users retain full access to view poems, download poems, like poems, and comment on poems without any restrictions
acceptanceCriteria: Non-admin users can view all poems on home page
Non-admin users can view individual poem details
Non-admin users can download poems as images
Non-admin users can comment on poems
Backend allows these read and interaction operations for all authenticated users

file_operations.description: Verify that the Home page displays poems for all users regardless of admin status. Ensure search functionality and collection filtering remain accessible to all authenticated users. No admin checks should block viewing poem cards or navigating to poem details.

Verify that the PoemDetail page allows all authenticated users to view poem content, download images (both original and generated), and add poems to their collections. Ensure download functionality and collection assignment remain accessible to non-admin users. No admin checks should restrict these read and interaction operations.

Verify that the PoemCard component allows all authenticated users to view poem information and add poems to collections via the dialog. Ensure the add-to-collection functionality remains accessible to non-admin users without admin checks.
